archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-07.5 Update and Improve Governance Mechanisms
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Finally, governance is not static — it evolves. Based on audit results, user feedback, or changes in law and technology, the organization updates its governance frameworks. Policies are refined, new controls are introduced, and outdated ones are retired. This continuous improvement loop ensures that governance remains current, adaptive, and effective as the organization modernizes.
Value created: Adaptive governance that keeps the organization compliant and future-proof.
